c: Whisk eggs and sugar over a bain-marie to 45 °C, then to ribbon; fold in sifted flour.
Spread 1 cm on a lined tray; bake 180 °C 10 min; cool; cut 10 discs.

c: Mix milk powder, sugar, dextrose and stabiliser dry (prevents lumps).
Heat milk and cream to 40 °C; whisk in the dry mix; continue to 85 °C, hold 2 min.
Balance rules: sugars 16–20%; solids 34–40%; dextrose up to 25% of sugars for softer scooping; swap 10% sugar for invert sugar to reduce crystals.
Cool in an ice bath to 4 °C; cover; mature 4–12 h at 0–4 °C.
Blend 1 min; batch-freeze to −8 °C extraction (about 25–35% overrun); fold in inclusions on extraction.
Fill pre-frozen trays; blast-harden −35 °C 1 h; transfer to −18 °C.
